column4: The same steep vertical bookshelf shaft descending deep underground, walls lined with stacked books and repeating shelf ledges, a ladder and dangling lamps, but completely empty: no people or figures anywhere; the middle route open; top and bottom bands simple enough to crop.

The exact same locked view and the same hooded worshippers in the same seats, but now every hood is raised, faces still hidden in shadow, looking up toward the stage; ledgers still closed on their laps.
The exact same lectern and camera, now the orange rulebook lies open with large blank ivory pages; a clean empty vertical space above the gutter.

A single hand in a dark sleeve poised with a fountain pen, seen from directly above in the same perspective as the ledger, isolated on a flat plain ivory background, sharp nib, compact wrist silhouette.
The exact same doors and camera, now the doors stand slightly ajar with a sharp blank ivory strip of light through the gap and across the threshold; the opening itself is flat blank ivory.

A standalone dawn sky plate: a wide open sky with a handful of unmistakably sheep-shaped fluffy clouds and a low horizon of meadow. For this image only use flat dusty blue and pale peach for the sky in addition to the three inks, with clean hard-edged shapes.
The exact same tall stained-glass window frame, camera and lead ribs, but all the central glass with the girl is gone; through the empty frame there is only flat solid ivory.
